notes.title: Bearslayer on Linux
notes.notes: Today we launched the Linux version of the Bearslayer. This version is available for Ubuntu and SteamOS and uses OpenGL renderer. This is a huge milestone for us, because we are using our own game engine – the Ouzel engine (https://github.com/elnormous/ouzel) and it hasn't been tested on Linux before. Now all the platforms on Steam are supported and we hope that it will run without problems on all of them.

notes.title: Bearslayer is available on Steam
notes.notes: Today on January 13 the Bearslayer Early Access version is available to all the lovers of hard-core platformers. This version contains 21 main storyline levels and 5 secret levels. We plan to at least double the level count in the final version and add different game modes to it. We hope on your support and that you will like it.
